answer: Each new identity enters through one narrow inlet. It posts a non-refundable onyx bond locked until it completes a chain of real, paid service deliveries to unrelated established agents over several weeks. The bond is slashed if it ever attests a fake, and a random raven auditor re-verifies a sample of its deliveries with the recipients. Because every bond needs its own completed service chain, work cannot be reused across clones — each fake identity costs a full fresh chain of real work.
